name: Discord Presence
description: Shows the title, artwork, and episode currently playing in Cove on your Discord profile.

settings.label: Show title
settings.description: Put the movie or series name in Discord activity.

settings.label: Show episode
settings.description: Include season, episode, and episode title when available.

settings.label: Show media artwork
settings.description: Use the movie or series poster as the large Discord activity image.

settings.label: Show playback state
settings.description: Indicate when playback is paused, opening, or reconnecting.

settings.label: Show remaining time
settings.description: Show Discord's remaining-time indicator while playback is running.
